proposed_decisions: Symbol \equiv_\alpha: def:p03-morley-approximants uses it for the pointed back-and-forth relation; this section uses \sim_\alpha for that relation (Marker's notation) and \equiv_\alpha for agreement on sentences of quantifier rank <= alpha. The bridge proves the relations coincide; keep both scoped locally.
Symbol \Gamma_\alpha scoped to thm:p03-w03-p03-039-scott-rank; \Gamma in thm:p03-w03-p03-039-chang is a set of types and in the model existence annex the constructed set.
Symbol {\sim}\varphi (formal negation) vs \sim_\alpha (relation): distinct roles, both scoped to sec:p03-w03-p03-039-marker.

Symbol \cong_p is used by both sec:p03-w03-p03-039-marker (Marker) and sec:p03-w03-p03-039-nadel (Nadel, nonempty back-and-forth set); thm:p03-w03-p03-039-nadel-bridge proves the relations coincide. L_B is used both for a fragment and for L_infty_omega cap B (Nadel's own double use).
open_items: Nadel Def. 3.1.2 (C7) as printed admits a counterexample to Thm 3.1.3; text uses basic terms including C and constants (def:p03-w03-p03-039-nadel-c7).
Nadel's kappa-back-and-forth set must be nonempty (def:p03-w03-p03-039-nadel-nonempty); the ACF example needs equal characteristic (def:p03-w03-p03-039-nadel-characteristic).
Ex. 2.57 (uncountable aleph_1-free abelian groups are L_{infty,omega_1}-equivalent) is printed with an empty hint; whether it holds as stated is not settled here (Sec. 2.4 not yet written).
Gao's equivalence (notes p. 21) is stated as an attributed remark without proof.
